notes: Corylus has a logo of its own: a hazel leaf whose veins are lines of text. Corylus is the botanical name of the hazel — the old European tree of writing and wisdom, which regrows from the stump instead of dying — so the name already said what the app is for. The green that comes with it replaces the stock blue the interface had been borrowing. The bearded fellow has not been retired; he is the mascot, and that was always his real job.
